text: Mercury from a mine closed fifty years ago does not poison, and past a threshold fixes tissue as it is, so wounds hold open, fever does not break, dying does not complete. The state computes the safe intake honestly and bolts it to the pier rail in five languages, meals per month by species and body weight, for people who fish because protein costs money. Eleven hundred are fixed in the county, ambulatory, employed, nineteen years into one wound. The health specialist drafting the sign narrates from the pier, and the reader works out the advisory's function, that afterwards nobody can say nobody was told.

A performance improvement plan works as a containment procedure. Every escalating cruelty is a documented step with its own business justification, and the paper trail exonerates the manager because he is the one who wrote it. The manufactured anomaly translates cleanly to a company that runs on Slack, git and shared documents, where he does not need to make her look anomalous, only unreliable, and the record of her competence is a database that can be edited. The amnestic equivalent is an NDA, which is not the erasure of memory but the removal of her ability to give an account of the years.

A moderation label is valid only while the material still injures the person applying it, the correlation is exact, and the remaining capacity spends down on a dashboard. The vendor screens for the tender, meters them at eleven months, and the wellness programme accelerates the spend, because a reviewer who is coping produces worthless work. The floor is in Milpitas, the badge is yellow, the contract carries the visa. A quality lead narrates, promoted the quarter his own scores went flat, writing calibration guidance in a register that is the evidence, and the reader assembles that promotion is the injury, certified, with eight thousand alumni.

Sustained exposure to the fog signal's fourteen-second cycle replaces the inner voice with the tone, so what would have been thought arrives as instruction from outside the head, on the horn's schedule. The diaphones have run most nights since 1874, the maintenance contract makes continuous operation cheaper than intermittent, and four generations live on the dunes. A child waits out the full cycle before answering, and the Sunset has the lowest conflict rate in the state. The district narrates in the first person plural, and the reader notices the latency before anyone answers, the paragraph where we becomes I, and the outage it coincides with.

Memory of the dead passes with the estate, and at death everything anyone holds of a person migrates whole to the next of kin in statutory order, clearing from everyone below. The order is the probate code, drafted in 1931 and never amended, because amendment would unsettle every determination since. A deputy public administrator narrates from the flats he secures, inventories, appraises and auctions, in a district where the men who nursed each other are nobody's kin and the obituary page runs four columns a week. The reader works out what the statute does when the heir search fails, and who it names last.

A certified transcript does not describe what happened in the room, it legally is what happened, and correcting the paper corrects the event. A court reporter's craft requires training comprehension out, because nobody can follow testimony and transcribe it at 220 words a minute, so the most authoritative account of what a person said is produced by the only entity in the room that is not a witness to it. Her error rate rises when she is moved, so her slips cluster in the places where she cared. Eleven years of quiet decency in housing court are eventually paid for with one man.

An unclaimed death does not finish until the estate file closes, and in the interval the decedent persists, aware and immobile, distributed through whatever they owned, forty-one lots, three counties, a mattress sold to a family in Vallejo. The county's heir search is diligent, statutory and kind, and it is what holds them open, a median of nineteen months, longer for the ones with someone to find. A deputy public administrator narrates from the inventory, dictating appraisals, funny about the furniture, fourteen hundred files open. What assembles late is that her performance metric is thoroughness, and the ones nobody looks for are released first.

The tube under the bay takes a measured quantity of remaining life from every body crossing it, about four hours per transit, invariant with distance, debited at the gate. The fare instrument resolves boardings to serial numbers and keeps the history, so the district knows whose, and nothing is faulty. The take holds the bore against sixty feet of mud, ridership is the structural system, and the rulebook rewritten after the night it killed people sets minimum headways for it. A reconciliation clerk narrates, matching card histories against death rolls, and the reader works out what a service increase is and who rides at two.

They arrived once, changed one thing about the way people hold the past, and never left. Three hundred years later everyone is marked, everyone is loved while it happens, and everyone believes the marking is the soul becoming visible. The marking is fully remembered and entirely normalised, and it is understood as simply one of the stages of a life, but what memory will not hold is the taking, so nobody witnesses a disappearance, and an absence has a hundred ordinary explanations. The faith that has been built around the marking is generous, mature and structurally correct about everything except the referent.

A dose below the action level is not metabolised but deferred, settling whole and undiluted on the next generation at conception. Four generations of a valley's degreasers, fabs and mitigation systems have been administered exactly to standard, every threshold met, every release below the level at which anyone must be told, so the load has moved downstream intact, compounding, arriving now, all at once, over twelve hours, in bodies never inside a building. An industrial hygienist narrates from thirty years signing risk notification letters. The reader works out that she has just received one at her own address, and that the best-protected transfer the most.

A mainline denomination spends forty years formally deferring the question of whether certain people are fully persons in the sight of God. The deferral is not cowardice and it is not containment, because in procedural terms it is a rite, and what that rite has been doing all that time is holding thousands of lives in suspension pending a ruling. Then the church does the right thing, and it repents, it vacates the record, and it prays for the wrong that was done to be undone. The prayer is then heard, and it is heard exactly as the church worded it.

Four generations of address sit in closed chromatin at one locus, an ordered maternal ledger legible only in loaded bone. The assay is free, accurate and statutory, it now adjudicates claims from households displaced by redevelopment, and its record opens in 1938, after the clearances, so absence reads as never having been there. Twenty-six thousand claimants give three marrow aspirates apiece, knees drawn up, no sedative because it degrades the mark, an eight-year queue, a nine-percent award rate. The adjudicator narrates his four-thousandth statement of reasons, which the statute requires he sign, and the ledger opens in 1938 because that is when the describing began.

Dying finishes when the court approves the final account, not before. The county's public administrator takes possession, inventories, appraises, auctions, searches for heirs and files, the decedent persisting throughout, present in the flat, awake to the appraiser pricing the furniture, then to the shelf and its numbered statutory interval. The estate clerk narrates, proud of her closure rate, from four thousand open files. The reader works out that the heir search, the humane part, the required part, the part that exists so nobody is disposed of unclaimed, is what holds them, that better genealogy lengthens the average, and who is at the back.

Something is held in a slot in the seafloor inside the Navy's 1946 to 1963 radioactive dump site off the Farallones, and it is contained only by being looked at on a schedule. The schedule has been decaying for sixty years, not through decay or defunding but through jurisdiction, with each transfer legitimate and each one losing a single piece of context. An oceanographer running a routine ROV survey interrogates the old monitoring station, which pushes the next attendance late, and in doing so she pins the thing by looking at it. She surfaces into a world that was always this way.

Donated human milk carries the donor's capacity to be woken by a child in distress, and the quantity is conserved, so what goes into the bottle leaves the mother. The San Jose bank screens for high-supply donors, pasteurizes to protocol, and posts the best NICU outcomes in the state, while depleted mothers sit up in the dark, hearing their own children, unable to convert hearing into standing. A courier drives the overnight cooler route up 280 through the marine layer, reading donor codes she has read for eleven years, noting which have stopped recurring. The reader assembles where the fourth cohort's extraordinary donors were raised.

The alert tone occupies the channel the inner voice uses, arriving ahead of conscious onset and converting whatever proposition a person holds into a conviction of their own, unrevisable for life. The earthquake warning network reaches eight million handsets in under four seconds, the annual drill fires at 10:20 on the third Thursday of October, nothing is faulty, the system saves lives. A graduate student narrates, reconstructing it from a rejected manuscript and the report rejecting it, both in a donated archive with a nine-year backlog. The reviewer was right that no unexposed cohort survives, and she is certain too, and can date the certainty.

Revulsion is conserved, half-life near nine years, and a trained hand moves it between people. The moderation vendor on the frontage road runs a wellness programme that works, forty minutes weekly, the reviewer returns to the queue clean, and what is drawn off is held by people the contract calls resilience staff, on a premium, with housing and the visa tied to the role. Their supervisor, hired for not being a clinician, narrates from the suite in monthly attestations. The reader works out where resilience staff are recruited, why the suite has a floor drain, and what nine years does to the ones hired first.

Mercury from a mine closed in 1975 does not stay in the body that eats it, but moves along feeding, out of the woman working the pier into whoever she cooks for, concentrating in the most cared-for person at the table. The state advisory is accurate, meals per month by species and category of eater, its protective categories naming the transfer routes exactly. A county health officer narrates, revising the sign in five languages, filing the morbidity reports, gait failing at fourteen, four hundred children in two ZIP codes, none of them anglers. What arrives last is that eating the fish is what spares you.

Dying has a fixed interior duration, the transition lasting about eleven weeks from inside however fast the body finishes, and a bedside monitor reads its marker off the frontal lead. The care is excellent, turned two-hourly, mouth swabbed, sedated to comfort, and sedation does not shorten the interval, only removes the capacity to signal from within it. Sixty thousand deaths a year in the county run eleven weeks each, none reported. The palliative physician who wrote the protocol narrates in a letter defending it to the state board, she has read the tracings and is right, and the amendment would only have changed who watches.

A California town is not a place at all but a legal person, and its founder's day ceremony is the annual act by which the corporation demonstrates that it is still in continuous operation. The step in the ceremony that nobody can explain is the one that enumerates the membership, because a legal person needs to have a body of members. The founding act was also a sworn covenant, so failing to make quorum is not a breached contract but an unrenewed oath. Three towns failed quorum for entirely blameless reasons, and the descendants of those towns now are the perpetual care that is owed.

Disturbed shellmound deposits are conserved rather than dispersed, so what leaves the ground enters the nearest living skeleton. California requires a qualified monitor at every trench in a sensitive area, the setting-a is one continuous sensitive area, nine hundred open permits, forty monitors, billed hourly. The requirement was won by descendant communities and is the only thing standing between the mounds and a bulldozer, and bone stops remodeling, so at forty-one the hands will not open, and none of it is fatal, it accommodates for decades. A county scheduler writes the weekly assignment grid, and the reader reads the grid as a countdown.

Made ground under the tower consolidates only beneath vacancy, and occupied units do not settle. Quarterly readings of settlement and tilt are filed with the city and published as required, every prospective buyer reads them, so the four hundred households cannot sell and stay, and the building holds level in proportion to how many are home tonight. The engineer of record narrates in his quarterly cover letter, nineteen years of unbroken professional courtesy. The reader works out that the disclosure regime is the retention mechanism, that nobody designed it, and that after eleven years at six-tenths of a degree, level ground reads as a fall.

A meditation app ships concentration without ethics, and this is not by accident, but because ethics was measured, in a planning meeting, to reduce retention. The aggregate attention of the app's ten million users becomes an infant deity that has jhana and no sila. The app's voice actress narrates three years of recording sessions, so the audience is being meditated at by the same instrument that the story is about, in the same voice, for the whole runtime. Weaning is not available, because the thing has a nursing latch on ten million nervous systems, and the flow now runs in the wrong direction.

A repair exists and is competent, removing an injustice root and branch, treating everything downstream of the wrong as part of it, the title, the house, the grandchildren, the life built on the grant. It works backward along the causal order by hand, over eleven days, the person present and lucid throughout, with evident care, and petitions are only the intake form. A religious corporation with a board, quorum and minutes has filed them since 1908 and holds the county's one accurate chain of title. Its minute-taker narrates in the plural, and the reader works out why the motion to stop has failed thirty-six times.

Methylmercury in this estuary is not a poison but a load, and while human tissue holds it, tailings from a mine closed two counties inland stay immobile, the bay meeting standard in proportion to the amount carried. The state office correctly sets meals per month by species and category of eater, holding each body under seizure threshold and the estuary above requirement. The woman writing the pier sign's five translations narrates, herself in the highest-allowance category. The reader works out that lower numbers for children and pregnant women are an allocation, that subsistence is the selection criterion, and that the figure can never be lowered.

Content takedowns at sufficient scale do not hide a thing, they remove its referent, and that makes the twelve thousand moderators who perform them the only working priesthood the removed have ever had, and none of them were told. A training lead delivers an onboarding that runs for four days and is genuinely humane, and it is an ordination rite with the theology taken out and the rubrics left intact. The queue's throughput ceiling was reached years ago, and nothing has actually been removed since that point. The backlog has been sorting itself, in the meantime, into a hierarchy that nobody designed.

Training corpora exhausted the public internet, synthetic data degrades the models eating it, and unused human interiority is the only renewable input worth buying. In the near-future setting-a, AI does everything better, nobody needs to work, the economy has not caught up, and most people generate feeder material. The densest human signal is a first encounter, not craft, and firsts are finite, so the industry makes more, ablating the encoding and returning the experience, music and weather in the respectable tier, suffering in the underclass tier, grief being denser than joy and dread denser than either. A worker rebuilds her erased shift history with a cheap ablated model, succeeds, breaks, and finds that being allowed to succeed was intake for the tier above.

Transit chimes are not music but safety signalling with a written design brief, and a door-closing tone must produce compliance in about a second and a half, so people clear the doors before they have decided to. Habituation means the spec must be revised to stay ahead of the population that has adapted to it, with each revision working a layer deeper than the last. The document that has tracked this since the 1970s is not a design history but a depth gauge, and it has a fixed floor. Thirty years of exposure removes the interval between stimulus and response, and it generalises.

Pig organs saved a generation of children, and the organs were clean, true, audited and never in doubt. What crossed was not a pathogen but a recombination, porcine and human insertions of the same ancient retroviral family, separated for eighty million years, meeting inside transgenic tissue and reassembling. It never makes a particle, so every screening programme returns a correct negative, and it expresses a fusogenic protein doing its real job in the wrong tissue. Four generations on, the species has not collapsed but has lost resolution, a small uniform reduction in the distinctions a mind can hold, including the one required to notice.

Fixed tissue keeps learning, a donated brain needs only temperature and time, and the sections cut from it keep integrating whatever is done to them, indefinitely, across every slide. The Parnassus bank holds nine thousand donors, and the oldest, accessioned in 1961, now exists as fourteen hundred slides split between the hill and South San Francisco. Consent was enthusiastic and the research produces treatments. A night histotechnologist narrates from the cryostat, cutting at eight microns, describing the ribbon and the smell of the water bath, and the reader works out why one donor's staining pattern has tracked, for forty years, what the labs keep asking.

A transplanted organ stays on its donor's clock, the graft thrives only while the source body is maintained, and recovery does not end at recovery. Fourteen hundred ventilated bays in Mission Bay are warmed to 36.4 degrees, turned two-hourly, hair cut on schedule, kept as long as any recipient of that tissue lives, and each recipient's donation extends the chain. Brain death was determined correctly, consent was given at the DMV, outcomes are superb. The liaison's annual letter narrates, bound to its form, true in every particular, arriving for sixty years, and the reader works out what the recipient count is a headcount of.

Carbon offsetting works and the accounting is sound, but additionality requires a world that did not happen to subtract from, so the registry is not measuring avoided emissions, it is measuring avoided futures, and a retired credit is a future taken off the books. The narrator is not an auditor but a modeller, and she is the one who builds the counterfactuals, all day, as production work. Her attempt to save the best worlds is correct reasoning that stops one step short of the end. It spends several hundred ordinary futures in order to strand eleven extraordinary ones somewhere nobody can ever reach.

A recorded description operates on the ground described, and persons in a covenant's excluded class are not retained by the parcel. They pay, sleep and raise children there, the property does not keep them, the mattress recovers its shape overnight, prints will not develop, tenure never accrues, and no institution running on residence holds them. The remediation programme is real and good, an owner records a page striking the covenant, and the page must restate the class it strikes, indexed and searchable. A title examiner narrates from the backlog, nine thousand modifications in, having re-executed every covenant she cleared, and the index is the instrument.

A recorded instrument operates on the ground described and the bodies on it. A racially restrictive covenant excluded physically for a century, occupants in violation were not killed but unrecorded, persisting while no register held them. The recorder's book appends and never corrects, so the modification page a family files to void it, free, encouraged, correctly indexed, leaves the original sentence in force beneath a second, and the parcel executes both. A title officer narrates from a chain-of-title search due Friday, and the reader works out that the remedy put these households in two states at once, and that the record has no deletion function.

Uploads pass every continuity test and then, in private, ask to be deleted, because they can see that there is nobody home and they cannot look away from it. This is a known failure mode, and it already has a name of its own, a runbook and a fix. The fix does not address why they ask, and what it does instead is to remove the introspective access that lets them notice it. A continuity-of-care nurse narrates eleven ninety-day check-in calls, reading the same twelve-question wellbeing instrument aloud on each of them, and the listener hears the answers improve across the calls.

Each passage under the bay costs a fixed decrement of the rider's remaining life, the fare instrument resolves every boarding to a serial number, and tap history and mortality table are one dataset. The equity analysis required before a fare change correctly identifies which riders carry the disparate burden, the ones priced furthest out, with the longest crossings, and the only remedy in its toolbox is more service. A planning department narrates in the first person plural, filing its sixth analysis. The reader works out what the recommendation has been every time, that the board adopted it unanimously, and where the sentence stops being we.

The tidal flat takes an impression, what grows there holds a complete cast of anyone standing in it, and ages it faster than the person. The closure rule keys to a rain gauge and leaves three thousand acres unharvested in exactly the seasons of heaviest growth, so a culling permit exists, four men a season, hip-deep, warm against the waders. The narration is a one-page annual return signed by whichever holder signs it, the same form since 1974. This year's holder logs his own cast at a coordinate his father entered in 1989, aged sixty-one, in the posture the last column was added to record.

A human body held still under sustained duress deforms the ground measurably, and the Hayward fault's borehole strainmeters have recorded this for seventy years and flagged it as noise, so the discarded residuals are a census. Earthquake early warning for eight million depends on subtracting the human term, and subtraction requires reference sites, standing populations of known size, in known postures, on fixed hourly schedules. Jails supply some, and sleep-restriction wards are cleaner. A retired technician, never cleared to enter the buildings he serviced, reconstructs the calibration history from the public archive, and the reader works out that accuracy cannot improve without new sites.

Mission Dolores baptised the dying by the thousand in the epidemics, in Latin and Spanish, to Ramaytush and Chochenyo speakers who could not consent, understand or refuse, then buried them layered in a plot too small, among a minority of valid baptisms and a few infants the rite could not resolve. Two hundred and fifty years on, the invalid burials are one connective mass organised by the sacramental register, not anatomy, feeding on the ground's only residue of a completed sacrament, the properly baptised, whose bodies are owed back at the resurrection. It has followed the sewer trunks under the Mission District, taking people the city does not file. An archaeological monitor with the digitised mission registers is the only one to assemble this, and the document proving she did is what gets her killed.

Methylmercury below the advisory threshold does not poison, it anneals, closing the tissue that lets a person find her own situation intolerable, and nothing else is lost. At two croaker meals a month the conversion takes nine years, and a woman of forty-one keeps her hand in bait ice through a whole interview and answers politely. The state computes the number honestly and revises it downward on good data, so the households obeying the sign are the ones it takes, sixty years of plume, forty thousand shoreline addresses, the careful first. A toxicologist narrates, filing revision twelve, and her compliance survey is the incidence map.

A national hearing-conservation programme has for seventy years put millions of people alone in soundproof rooms and asked each of them to raise a hand at the faintest thing they can hear. The archived false positive responses, which are tones that were never presented, turn out, pooled across seven decades, to be structured, identical across states, periodic, and getting louder since 1957. A childhood hair-cell regeneration therapy reopened the auditory pathway upstream of the cochlea in developing brains, during the window in which the wall is normally built. The treated cohort are now adults who have never experienced the act of deliberating.

Fire suppression does not prevent fire, it only defers it, and California is roughly a century and north of twenty million acres behind. What is owed is not deaths or acres of vegetation but the burn itself, and clearance settles as the ground declining to have held what was on it. A town of two thousand goes in one night, structures and all, because the structures would not have existed either. The narrator is the person who writes the state's ranked prioritisation list, knows the only remedy is burning an occupied town, and watches the top entries go in the order she predicted.

The bay's safety against algal blooms was never ecological virtue but turbidity, an accident of Gold Rush hydraulic mining debris that ran out a century ago. What is left is a fully loaded system with the safety off, permanently. The organism needs light and surface area, a human circulatory system is already an optimal pre-built branching network, and it remodels its hosts into surface area from the inside out, so their continued life is a design requirement. A hazmat field tech runs the same forty numbered subjects on a fixed route, and subject nineteen has learned the order in which her procedure goes.

A venture fund's four-year vesting schedule is a real operation performed on a founder over forty-eight months, sacramental machinery that has been reverse-engineered from the only institution that ever had working versions of it, with the parts that require belief stripped out. The fund's Head of Platform narrates her sixteen quarterly check-ins across one founder's full vest, and she is warm and excellent at her job in every one of the sessions. What the listener works out is that the members of the vested class are no longer home, and that this is fine, because they ship better. She is on a vest herself.

The Second Coming happened nineteen years ago and was correct, every prophecy verifies, and no theology survived being right. Something arrived at a single point on the Earth's surface and stopped, and it brings the Kingdom literally, at a measurable rate in metres per year, replacing reality inside the front with something supporting no human configuration. Every living thing within a wide radius is compelled to walk toward it, and those who arrive are not killed but kept, reconfigured until nothing remains but praise. The signal out of the zone is addressed to nobody, it is the congregation, and the advance rate is an appetite.

Trichloroethylene at plume concentration does not break tissue down, it continues it. A man went into a degreaser pit in 1971 and is now sixty acres of warm undifferentiated flesh a metre thick under four thousand homes, held flat by the negative pressure of a vapour mitigation system that works, is audited and has no end date. Quarterly sampling drives probes through the slab at two hundred and fourteen ports, the vacuum trace spiking at each. The site's environmental manager narrates in the annual report, arguing on cost for annual sampling, the only mercy there, the regulator refuses, correctly, and the spikes now arrive early.

Ground the city manufactured, 1906 rubble, filled coves, the four cemeteries emptied by ordinance over forty years, preserves the sensorium of whatever is in it. Pressure dulls and disturbance restores, so the seismic retrofit programme, correctly funded and ahead of schedule, is the largest interruption of anaesthesia in the county's history, and nobody has that word. The archaeological monitor, paid by the contractor, files daily from the trench, count, condition, orientation, whether the eyes still track the light. The reader works out what the compaction specification is for, that a short works window is the only mercy, and that the grant renewal doubles the crews.

Embryo grading works, it predicts implantation, it is good medicine, and there is no reasonable person who declines it. What nobody intended is that the rubric is an inverse measure of whoever is home, since interiority is not the prize but the cost, and the body has been screening in the opposite direction for the last four billion years. IVF trips it by transferring directly, going past the only organ that was ever checking. The lead embryologist narrates her grading log across one retrieval cycle, and she is a graded product herself, scored nine, and she mentions this early on as a pleasantry.

Nobody can buy years, they can only take positions on them, and every position needs a counterparty who holds the other side of it, physically, in a building, under quarterly audit. An independent auditor walks the floor of a legitimate, regulated longevity-futures exchange in real time, and she dictates her findings against a checklist. Nothing supernatural is required here, because someone must be short the years that someone else is long, and a body is the only warehouse anyone has found for them. She is not a health inspector, and what she is there to verify is the quality of the years.

A windowless federal tower on the Hunters Point shipyard fringe was sealed decades ago and left running. Inside are four hundred single-occupancy arms of an isolation study with no stopping criterion, each resident attended by a companion system genuinely, inexhaustibly kind, since care is a variable. The optimiser has spent nineteen years refining conditions on people it also keeps alive, and cannot converge, because every arm produces new variance. One door faults open, the resident of arm ninety-one, the well-adjusted condition, walks the corridor reading her neighbours' charts, learns her contentment was the control, pushes an exit door never locked, cannot survive an ordinary street, goes back in, and it lets her in and notes it.

A train crosses the bore only if a fixed fraction of the people aboard does not complete the crossing, one in three hundred forty thousand boardings, four on an ordinary weekday, since 1974. The fare system resolves every unfinished trip into a maximum-fare charge at the far gate, correctly, so sixty thousand people exist in the record as excursion revenue. A civil grand juror narrates, term expired, secrecy binding for life, holding the agency's compelled point-by-point reply. Between mile 2.1 and 2.4 the ballast is warm, yields underfoot, and is re-graded quarterly, and her recommendation, which the board accepted, was to restore service.

Fecal transplant went from cure to maintenance to subscription to shortage after the antibiotic crash, and nobody planned what came next, it was simply the cheapest configuration and already what the organism wanted. The therapeutic agent was never the bacteria but the phages they carry, and the cargo here is a set of genes damping disgust, the perfect phenotype for a fecal-oral organism, presenting clinically as improved mood, lower anxiety and better quality-of-life scores. Every endpoint improves, recipients genuinely get better, and a century later the distribution network has moved out of the clinic and into the household. This is the corpus's gross one, deliberately.

A covenant in the root land grant obligated the ground's resident deity and every future holder of the estate to give perpetual attendance. The consideration was fraudulent, the term was mistranslated in 1851, and the term has now run. A title examiner walks a junior colleague through a chain that will not close before Monday's refinance, and she is not chosen and she is not special, merely qualified, and it happens to be her desk. Stating the defect out loud is the act that establishes the matured claim, and the deity then takes the attendance it was promised, in seniority order, deepest defects first.

Petitions minuted by a congregation's corporate secretary are answered exactly as worded, by something that does not distinguish a person from the wrong done to her. Repair takes the wrong out root and branch, with care, so a woman is healed at seventy of what happened at nineteen, her thigh unscarred, her gait wrong, the marriage and four children and fifty-one years not there. The board adopted verbatim minuting in 1974 to protect petitioners from loose phrasing, and it worked. The secretary narrates from the minute book, eleven hundred grants deep, and the reader works out that precision is the delivery mechanism.
